name: claimgate
display_name: ClaimGate - claim check before you publish
description: Check marketing copy against the evidence you hold: which claims cannot be substantiated, which of your own policy rules it breaks, and whether an AI disclosure is missing.

tools.name: check_draft
tools.description: Check a draft against your evidence and report, in plain English, every claim that cannot be substantiated.

tools.name: check_draft_json
tools.description: The same check returned as structured JSON for a pipeline or CI gate.

tools.name: list_claims
tools.description: List the claims in a draft and what each one needs, without judging them.

tools.name: check_policy_only
tools.description: Check a draft against a policy alone - prohibited claims and AI disclosure; no evidence and no model needed.

tools.name: about
tools.description: What this server is, what it does not do, and how to verify it.
